statement: Elemental-fcc B0 dispersion is anti-correlated with median B0 error and cannot license B0 correction, cross-class transfer, or uncertainty semantics.

premises.statement: The class-stratified fcc B0 dispersion-error relationship is negative and contradicts an uncertainty or cross-class correction license.

lean_theorem.reason: The observed Spearman anti-correlation is statistical evidence, not a formally proved theorem.

excluded_scope: bcc a0, which has a separate empirical dispersion-error license
Material classes other than elemental fcc metals
